query: Need a deep orange soy candle for my friend's birthday, please include gift wrapping.

products.title: Large Orange Blossom Soy Wax Candle
products.description: The Large Orange Blossom Soy Wax Candle by Estella Bartlett is a luxurious scent designed to fill a room with a clean citrus fragrance. Created in collaboration with specialist British perfumers, it features notes of Blood Orange, Petit-Grain, and Geranium. The candle is made from vegan soy wax with a cotton wick, offering approximately 34 hours of burn time. It comes neatly packaged in a box featuring the message 'Positive Vibes', making it an ideal gift or self-care treat.
key_features: Packaged in a 'Positive Vibes' gift box

products.title: Dessert Candles® Orange Sorbet Soy Candle
products.description: Dessert Candles® brings a sweet touch to your home with this Orange Sorbet soy candle. Featuring a playful, dessert-inspired design with a frosted topper and citrus accents, this candle is crafted from a soy wax blend for a clean and steady burn. Perfect for adding a cozy atmosphere to a room or as a thoughtful gift for a hostess.
key_features: Dessert-inspired look with frosted topper and citrus accents
Soy wax blend for a clean, steady burn

products.title: Cranberry Orange Soy Candle
products.description: A hand-poured soy candle with a quintessential seasonal scent featuring tart cranberry and zesty citrus balanced with warm spices. It is made from 100% U.S.-grown soybean wax with a cotton core wick, and is vegan, gluten-free, paraben-free, and phthalate-free.

products.title: Moroccan Terracotta Soy Candle
products.description: Handcrafted in Marrakesh, Morocco, this Moroccan Terracotta Soy Candle features a warm amber scent housed in a handmade glazed terracotta vessel. The natural soy wax creates a soothing atmosphere, and once the candle is burned through, the rustic cup can be repurposed as a decorative accent, a small storage container, or a coffee cup.
key_features: Handmade glazed terracotta cup crafted by artisans in Marrakesh, Morocco
Natural soy wax blended with a rich amber fragrance
Reusable vessel can be repurposed for coffee, storage, or home decor

products.title: Single Wick Candle
products.description: Savor a refined fragrance inspired by Capri with this Sweet Orange + Agave Single Wick Candle. This candle features a bright, fruity scent combining orange, mandarin, lemon, and lime with soft white blooms and golden agave nectar. It is housed in a unique, textured ceramic vessel and crafted with an exclusive soy wax blend for an even, consistent burn of up to 45 hours.
key_features: Up to 45 hours of room-filling scent
Even, consistent burn from start to finish
Ceramic jar with a dust cover and box

products.title: Moroccan Terracotta Soy Candle
products.description: A handmade terracotta glazed candle vessel from Morocco houses amber scented soy wax. Crafted in Marrakesh, each cup features hand-glazed finishes with a cream and terracotta color block. The candle offers a warm amber aroma, and once burned, the ceramic cup can be repurposed as a decorative piece or small storage. Specifications include a compact size and weight, with care instructions noting hand-washing due to terracotta’s porous nature and minor glaze cracking that may occur from artisanal production.
key_features: Cream and terracotta color block glaze
Dimensions: approx 2.5 inches height x 2.6 inches diameter

products.title: Citrus Soy Candle Bundle
products.description: This Citrus Soy Candle Bundle from Broken Top Brands features three of their most popular citrus-scented 9oz soy candles: Rio Ruby Red, Fresh Squeezed, and Citrus Herbed Tonic. Each candle is hand-poured using 100% U.S.-grown soybean wax, cotton core wicks, and fine fragrance oils. These vegan, gluten-free, paraben-free, and phthalate-free candles offer a clean burn and are designed to provide approximately 50 hours of fragrance.
key_features: Includes Rio Ruby Red, Fresh Squeezed, and Citrus Herbed Tonic scents
Approximately 50 hour burn time per candle

products.title: Wellness Soy Candle
products.description: The Woolzies Wellness Soy Candle is a 100% natural soy wax candle designed to create a bright and balanced atmosphere. Scented with a blend of Orange and Ylang Ylang essential oils, it offers a fresh, uplifting aroma with juicy citrus and soft floral notes. This eco-friendly candle provides up to 55 hours of burn time and comes in a beautiful, gift-ready presentation, making it ideal for home fragrance, self-care routines, or gifting.
key_features: Scented with Orange & Ylang Ylang Essential Oils
Perfect for home fragrance, self-care & gifting
